question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
-- Final answer
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND (SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END)) 
           / SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) >= 0.20
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city FROM city_sales
),
product_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS sales_q4_2020,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776) THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    JOIN products p ON s.prod_id = p.prod_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
total_sales_by_quarter AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1772 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS total_q4_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_quarter_id = 1776 THEN s.amount_sold ELSE 0 END) AS total_q4_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN countries co ON c.country_id = co.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'United States of America'
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_quarter_id IN (1772, 1776)
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
),
product_with_shares AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.prod_id,
        ps.total_sales,
        ts.total_q4_2019,
        ts.total_q4_2020,
        1.0 * ps.sales_q4_2019 / ts.total_q4_2019 * 100 AS share_q4_2019,
        1.0 * ps.sales_q4_2020 / ts.total_q4_2020 * 100 AS share_q4_2020,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC) AS tile
    FROM product_sales ps
    CROSS JOIN total_sales_by_quarter ts
),
top_20 AS (
    SELECT * FROM product_with_shares WHERE tile = 1
)
SELECT p.prod_id, p.prod_name, t.share_q4_2019, t.share_q4_2020,
       t.share_q4_2020 - t.share_q4_2019 AS pct_point_change
FROM top_20 t
JOIN products p ON t.prod_id = p.prod_id
ORDER BY ABS(t.share_q4_2020 - t.share_q4_2019) ASC
LIMIT 1
